title: Validate sign-up fields against an allow-list

cases.says: username("alice99") and age("42") are accepted; a null username, "a b" and age "abc" are refused with IllegalArgumentException.
"bob!" and "bob\nrm" are refused even though they start with a valid username, because the pattern must match the whole input.
Usernames of exactly 3 and exactly 20 characters are accepted; 2 and 21 are refused.
The full-width username "ａｌｉｃｅ" is normalized with NFKC to "alice", validated in that form and returned in that form.
A username with a Cyrillic "а" that looks like the Latin "a" is refused, because normalization does not remove homoglyphs.
Ages "0" and "150" pass, while "151", "-1", "+42" and Arabic-Indic digits are refused, although Integer.parseInt reads the last two.
